title: Pan-Seared Pancetta Chicken with Indian Curry Sauce
description: A fusion of Italian and Indian flavors in this quick and easy dish. The pancetta adds a rich savory taste while the curry sauce brings a warm and aromatic flavor.
instructions: 1. Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and curry powder.
2. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 slices of pancetta and cook until crispy.
3. Remove the pancetta from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides.
7. Add the curry sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
8. Simmer the sauce for 5-7 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
9. Serve the chicken with the curry sauce and crispy pancetta on top.
